title: Semio Logo Raster Fixture and Import Export
description: Introduce a new top-level raster technology for non-destructive, multi-windowed image editing on an infinite canvas. Built on infinite_canvas Rust/WASM/Vello. Layers, masks, blend modes, adjustment layers, painting, filters. Integrated with shared hover/selection, side-panel-tree, ribbon-tool-tree, multi-window shell. Sophisticated playground.
summary: Consolidated raster to a single Semio logo fixture (`semio.raster.json`) embedding the round emblem PNG with a full layer stack: groups, masks, blend modes, clip-to-below, all four adjustment kinds, and all filter kinds. Removed default/paint/photo-edit fixtures. Extended `raster.document/v1` with `assets` (base64 images) and per-layer `filters`; added sync/export helpers and WASM `uploadRasterImageKey` so embedded logos render after import. Wired Import Raster / Export Raster toolbar commands with file-bridge download and file-picker load for JSON round-trip.
